text: Ilse's new puppy arrives Saturday morning, a little cocker spaniel called Biscuit. She's already bought three beds for it
Farah is presenting to the Novak client on Thursday at 2pm and she's properly nervous about it. Text her good luck Thursday morning
Joy's cat Pepper had a lump removed yesterday, vet says results back in about a week. She sounded wrecked
caroline promoted to team lead!! starts officially 2 November 2026. need to get her a card

Bilal running the Cardiff half on Sunday, first one ever. been training since March, says his knee is holding up but he's terrified of hitting the wall around mile ten. his girlfriend Aditi is driving down Saturday afternoon to cheer. he wants a sub 2 hour time. text him Saturday night good luck and then Sunday afternoon to ask his time
Pedro said the band's gig at the Crown on the 14th at half 8 is cancelled, drummer quit. They're doing an acoustic set at his sister's party instead
Anan mentioned his boss is leaving at the end of the month and nobody knows who's replacing her. He's a bit anxious about it tbh
so Isla and her husband Thomas are going to see Hamilton in March 2027, it's for their tenth anniversary, she's been wanting to go for years
Eilidh's piano recital Friday at 6. her mum says she practises every night and still thinks she'll forget the middle bit
Remind me to ask Tamar how the pitch with Wang Logistics went yesterday afternoon
Matilda loves anything with foxes on it, mugs, prints, socks. Birthday's in January
Haruto has a dog called Miso, a shiba. Allergic to chicken apparently so he has to cook its food
Coffee with Rebecca. Her dad's having his hip done on the 3rd, she's taking the week off to look after him. Should ring her the weekend after to see how he's getting on
sean got into the county squad!! first match is 9 November 2026 at 11am away at Ashford. absolutely buzzing
Mia's new manager, Joe, seems nice but keeps scheduling meetings at 8am. She hates early starts
vet tomorrow at 10:15 for the booster jabs, then pick up dog food on the way back
Hamza and his wife are expecting, due in April. Their eldest Kasia has started calling the bump "the sausage"

Jakub said the client review got moved from Monday to Wednesday at 4. He's worried they'll pull the contract because the last two deliveries were late, and that's not even his fault, it was the supplier. His manager Rebecca is going in with him. He's not sleeping well. I said I'd look over his slides tomorrow morning before 10, and I should grab him a coffee after the meeting either way
tanvi's choir has a concert at St Mary's on Saturday 7th Dec 7.30pm. she's got a solo!! wants us to come. don't forget to book tickets

Asha's rabbit Clover died at the weekend. She'd had her nine years, got her the same month she moved into the flat. Asha is really cut up, didn't go into work Monday. Her other rabbit Bramble is pining as well and won't eat much, she's taking him to the vet Thursday at 5. Message her tonight and maybe drop round some flowers at the weekend
Stefan is vegan now, has been since the summer, so no cheese board for the team lunch on Friday
Imogen told me in confidence she's interviewing at Osei & Partners next Tuesday morning. Hasn't told anyone at work

Um, voice note. Sam's dog Rolo went missing last night, they found him this morning two streets away in someone's shed, totally fine, just hungry. Sam is still shaking though, she was up till 3 putting posters out. Her husband James wants to get him chipped properly now because the old chip wasn't registered. She said she owes the neighbours a bottle of wine. I should check on her tomorrow
Kasia did her grade 5 violin exam this morning, results in about six weeks. She thinks the scales went badly
James Walsh, Jimmy to everyone, retires on the 28th after thirty years. Leaving drinks at the Fox at 5pm that day. Need to chip in for the collection by Wednesday
Bethany's sister Joy is getting married in Lisbon in June 2027. Bethany's maid of honour and already stressing about the speech
Aditi - new job at the hospital trust, starts Monday 9am. Lives in Didsbury now with her partner

Voice note. Okay so Arturo rang, his daughter Emily has her first proper swimming gala on Saturday at the leisure centre, warm up is at eight, races start at nine. She's really nervous about the 50 metre backstroke because she got disqualified last time for a turn. He asked if I could come, I said yes. I should bring a sign or something, she'd love that. Also need to ask him about the car share for next week
Joe's kitten is called Pixel, tabby, about 12 weeks old. He sent me about forty photos
Emily Brennan from accounts says the audit starts 2 November 2026 and goes on for two weeks. She's dreading it
Ilse and Farah are doing the 10k together on the 19th, both raising money for the cat rescue
Sorted the gym membership, first induction is Wednesday at 7am. Must actually go
dr Rossi's assistant Caroline called, my appointment moved to the 12th at half 9

Pedro's mum turns 70 next month, big party at their place on the 22nd at 1pm. Pedro reckons she'd like a garden voucher, she's obsessed with her roses and lost half of them in the summer. His brother Joe is flying in from Toronto the Thursday before. I'm doing the cake, lemon drizzle because she doesn't like chocolate. Pedro asked me to keep it quiet in case she wants a smaller do
Talked to Bilal after the match. Their team lost the semi 3-1 and he's gutted, he missed a penalty. I should check in with him at the weekend, he takes these things hard
Anan's daughter starts nursery on Monday. He's more nervous than she is
Isla says Haruto is moving to the Manchester office in March 2027, he's dead excited but his wife isn't keen
Eilidh's hamster Nugget turns two on Sunday. she is throwing it a party. I am not joking
call Tamar back re the Lewis account tomorrow before 10

Matilda got the part of Lady Macbeth in the uni play!! opening night is Thursday 27th at 7, runs till Saturday. she's never had a lead before and she's a bit overwhelmed with lines, rehearsals every night this week until 10. her flatmate Isla is doing the lighting. we're going Friday night with her parents. get her flowers for after
Thomas is off sick again, back problems. His manager has been weird with him about it, he's thinking of going to HR

Long call with Rebecca. Her greyhound Dolly has to have a tooth out on Tuesday, then her own scan is Wednesday morning at the Royal, and on top of that her landlord wants them out by 1 December 2026. She's exhausted honestly and sounded close to tears. Her partner Sean is working away until the 15th so she's doing it all on her own. I want to take her some food on Thursday evening and should text her Wednesday afternoon after the scan to see how it went
Mia says she's training for the Great North Run next September, wants to do it under two hours
Hamza's brother Stefan is a session drummer, played on a couple of albums. Said he'd get us on the list for his gig on Friday at the Leadmill, doors at 7
Jakub's leaving do is off, he's decided to stay after they matched the offer
Tanvi's grandad died on Tuesday, funeral is next Friday at 11. She's flying to Leicester Thursday night. Must send flowers
Asha mentioned her husband Pedro has been dropping hints about a new turntable for Christmas. She's thinking of the Rega one
Stefan's performance review is Thursday at 3pm, first one with the new director. Remind me to text him after
Imogen's kids are in the school nativity on the 16th, 2pm. Her youngest is a sheep and very serious about it
Sam started at the agency last week, says the clients are a nightmare but the team are great. Moving to the design side in the new year
dentist Monday 4pm, MOT Tuesday morning, council tax by the 1st
Kasia Novak - her cat Luna had kittens on Saturday, five of them. She's keeping one and asked if I want one. Ask Bethany if she's still after a cat
James mentioned he's been doing a pottery class on Tuesday nights. Made a wonky bowl he's very proud of

had lunch with Bethany. she's applying for the head of marketing role, deadline Friday at midday, interview would be the week of 2 November 2026. her boss Arturo has said he'll back her. she's quietly confident but worried about the presentation part. I need to send her that deck I did last year tonight
Aditi's dad's 60th - surprise dinner Saturday 8pm at the Italian on Bold St. Don't say anything to him if I see him
Arturo's team won the five a side league last night!! Trophy and everything. He's insufferable
Emily's driving test is tomorrow at 8.40 am. Third attempt. Wish her luck tonight
Joy says Caroline and her girlfriend Ilse got engaged in Paris last weekend. Should send them a card, Joy said they're doing drinks on 12 December at 7
Haruto messaged, Stefan's band came third at the battle of the bands on Saturday. They're playing the final heat in March 2027
Farah's been off work a couple of weeks with anxiety. Went back Monday, part time for now. Text her Friday to see how the week went
